# Docs

Write plain English per the Simple English skill. Read
`.github/skills/simple-english/SKILL.md` and apply its Document rules.

Keep the flat top-level docs. Do not add a `docs/` tree or a wiki. Record
`Source:` and `Last-checked:` in `DECISIONS.md` for decisions that rest on
external documentation.
